title: thermo-piston widget params
description: Per-question configuration for the Class-11 Thermodynamics piston / First-Law widget. All fields optional — defaults reproduce the legacy Cabinet question (1/1/11/3/44/22) bounds.

heatMin.description: Lower bound of the heat slider in Joules (default -200).

heatMax.description: Upper bound of the heat slider in Joules (default +200).

workMax.description: Absolute bound for piston work in Joules (default 200).

workStep.description: Per-click increment of the piston work buttons in Joules (default 5).

title.description: Optional title shown above the simulation.

initialVolume.description: Accepted for backwards compatibility with the legacy migration default (#212). Unused by the widget.

maxHeat.description: Accepted for backwards compatibility with the legacy migration default (#212). Unused by the widget.
